epic.title: Windows-path-form fix for tests/test_spine_origin_isolation.py
epic.intent_and_why: The worktree-identity refusal test's cwd-side assertion compared a foreign path with str() instead of as_posix(), which would false-fail on Windows where the refusal message is built from git's always-posix toplevel output but the test-side path renders with native separators. Fix the one assertion so PR #588's Windows CI comparison stays clean.
